title: Additional Hidden Costs in Award of Contracts to Overseas Tenderer for Mid-Autumn Festival 2016 and Chinese New Year 2017
what_it_is: Additional Hidden Costs in Award of Contracts to Overseas Tenderer for Mid-Autumn Festival 2016 and Chinese New Year 2017

sections.label: Chingay event additional expenses
sections.summary: The organiser knew of additional expenses, bearing about $34,000 per event yearly from 2014 to 2016.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: The organiser was well aware of these additional expenses as they had been bearing the cost every year, which averaged about $34,000 for each event from 2014 to 2016.

sections.label: Chingay reimbursement claims investigation
sections.summary: An independent panel was set up in June 2018 to check Chingay 2017 procurement and past overseas purchases; PA referred the matter to Police.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: Pertaining to the reimbursement claims made by a People's Association (PA) staff member for overseas purchases for Chingay, an independent investigation panel led by a senior officer in the Ministry of Culture, Community and Youth was also set up in June 2018 to check on Chingay 2017 procurement, as well as to review past overseas Chingay purchases and payments.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: PA has referred the matter to the Police and will fully cooperate with the Police in its investigations.

sections.label: Chingay overseas procurement non-compliance
sections.summary: PA's internal audit had earlier identified that Chingay's overseas procurement practice did not fully comply with approved procedures.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: Although AGO did not previously flag out similar observations on Festivals and Chingay procurement, PA’s own internal audit had earlier identified that Chingay's practice of overseas procurement did not fully comply with approved procedures.

sections.label: Cash overseas purchases reimbursement
sections.summary: A question was raised about paying almost $150,000 in cash for overseas purchases and seeking reimbursement using cash receipts.

sentences.speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat (Hougang)
sentences.text: Which Government agency would allow its staff to conduct parallel quotations and also to pay almost $150,000 in cash for overseas purchases and seek reimbursement using cash receipts?

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: There is a current process of investigation and whoever is responsible will be taken to task.

sections.label: PA accounts not qualified
sections.summary: The AGO and auditors have never made any comment that PA's accounts are qualified.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: The AGO and the auditors have never, never made any comment that the PA's accounts are qualified.

sections.label: AGO audit of AHPETC
sections.summary: AGO's 2015 audit of AHPETC concluded there was no assurance its accounts were accurate, reliable, or that public funds were properly managed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: When AGO audited Aljunied-Hougang-Punggol East Town Council (AHPETC) in 2015, AGO concluded that there was "no assurance that AHPETC's accounts are accurate and reliable, or that public funds are properly spent, accounted for, and managed".

sections.label: PA accounts adverse opinion history
sections.summary: The speaker says PA had many years of qualified accounts before 2007, and adverse opinions from 2007 to 2012.

sentences.speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat
sentences.text: No, I am saying history, PA has many years of qualified accounts before 2007, if you look.

sentences.speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat
sentences.text: I looked through all the reports; 2007 to 2012, it has adverse opinion.

sections.label: Auditors on tender and storage costs
sections.summary: Auditors suggested tender cost, storage and transportation be considered in full rather than separately, and the organiser may not have considered both parts entirely.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: What the auditors found and suggested for improvement is that not only the tender cost for the products but also the storage and the transportation be considered in full rather than separately.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: The cost has been made clear, the organisers have been aware of both sets of costs but, perhaps, the inadequacy of the organiser was not to consider the two parts in its entirety.

sections.label: Auditors' suggestion for future tenders
sections.summary: The auditors suggested that going forward the product tender and storage and transportation costs be conducted in its entirety, which has been done.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: The question and the suggestion by the auditors are that, going forward, instead of considering the two separately, the tender for the product separately from the storage and transportation costs, that the two should be conducted in its entirety.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: We will do that and we have done that to rectify it.

sections.label: AHPETC accounts unreliable 2012 to 2017
sections.summary: AHPETC's auditors found its accounts unreliable from fiscal year 2012 to 2017 and gave disclaimers of opinion; AGO found no assurance accounts were accurate.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: First, and I repeat, the accounts of AHPETC, or known as AHTC, have been found by its auditors to be unreliable from fiscal year 2012 to 2017.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: Its auditors, the Member's auditors, repeatedly gave the Town Council a disclaimer of opinion as they were "not able to obtain sufficient appropriate audit evidence to provide a basis for an audit opinion." When AGO audited AHPETC in 2015, AGO concluded that there was "no assurance that AHPETC's accounts are accurate and reliable or their public funds are probably spent, accounted for and managed".

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: AGO has consistently given the Government an unmodified audit opinion on its financial statements.

sections.label: KPMG and AGO lapses in AHTC
sections.summary: KPMG described controlled failures in AHTC as pervasive across five years, and AGO found 150 lapses in 2015 and KPMG 70 more in 2016.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: Second, quoting KPMG's opinion in its July 2016 report, the controlled failures in AHTC were "pervasive, cross-cutting across the key areas of governance, financial control, financial reporting, procurement and records management over the course of five years." AGO also found 150 lapses in 2015 and KPMG uncovered a further 70 controlled failures in AHTC in 2016.

sections.label: Lawsuit against AHTC Town Councillors
sections.summary: The lawsuit against AHTC Town Councillors claims breach of fiduciary duties, duty of care and negligence, brought by an independent panel, not the Government.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: The current lawsuit against the AHTC Town Councillors is based on claims for (a) breach of core fiduciary duties; (b) breach of duty in their capacity as fiduciaries to diligently exercise reasonable care and skill in the exercise of their powers and in the discharge of their responsibilities; and (c) breach of duty of care to AHTC under the common law tort of negligence.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: The independent panel was appointed under the Town Councils Act pursuant to a consent order made between the AHTC and the Housing Development Board before the Court of Appeal to take such actions as the independent panel thinks it is in AHTC's best interest in light of the inappropriate payments that were identified.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: The key point is that the lawsuit was not brought by the Government.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: Government financial accounts are reliable and public funds are properly accounted for.
